name: p14_1_selection_sort_desc
nat_lang_statement: Modify the selection sort algorithm to sort an array of integers in descending order.

ensures: forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < arr.Length ==> sorted[i] >= sorted[j]

name: p14_4_merge_sort_strings
nat_lang_statement: Modify the merge sort algorithm to sort an array of strings in lexicographic order.

ensures: forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < sorted.Length ==> sorted[i] <= sorted[j]
forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length ==> exists j :: 0 <= j < sorted.Length && arr[i] == sorted[j]

name: binary_search
nat_lang_statement: Write a telephone lookup program that reads names and telephone numbers from a file and handles lookups by name using binary search.

dafny.method_signature: binary_search(a: array<(string, nat)>, key: string) returns (result: Option<nat>)
requires: forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < a.Length ==> a[i].0 <= a[j].0 // array is sorted by the first element
ensures: result.None? ==> forall i :: 0 <= i < a.Length ==> a[i].0 != key

name: p14_7_bubble_sort
nat_lang_statement: Implement the bubble sort algorithm described in Exercise R14.19.

ensures: forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < sorted.Length ==> sorted[i] <= sorted[j]
forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length ==> exists j :: 0 <= j < sorted.Length && arr[i] == sorted[j]
